verdict.rationale: Extend documents a unified API (parse/extract/classify/split) and explicitly maintains a 'Supported File Types' reference page, plus quickstart/CLI/SDK docs pointing to one API surface for all documents, and community feedback confirms real-world use on 'hardest documents' with good accuracy. However, the evidence pack never surfaces the actual list of supported formats (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, images, email) or confirms no per-format configuration is needed. Missing for 10: enumerated format list content, explicit confirmation that no per-format code paths are required, independent testing across multiple format types.
